description: OpenAI’s “code red” has reportedly reached its end, nearly four months after the company CEO declared it. In December 2025, reports claimed that Sam Altman declared a code red, keeping every non-ChatGPT project on hold. Ever since then, the San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) giant has released three new AI models and multiple new features for the popular chatbot.
title: ChatGPT Adult Mode Delayed Again as OpenAI's 'Code Red' Reportedly Ends

description: Infrared observations from the James Webb Space Telescope refined the orbit of asteroid 2024 YR4, confirming it will safely pass about 21,200 km above the Moon in December 2032. The new data eliminates earlier estimates that suggested a small chance of a lunar impact.
title: NASA’s Webb Telescope Confirms Asteroid 2024 YR4 Will Safely Pass the Moon in 2032

description: Lava Bold 2 5G will be launched in India by the Noida-based smartphone maker on March 13 at 12 pm IST, the company has confirmed. The phone will be available for purchase in the country via Amazon. The handset is teased to be offered in at least a black colour option, too. The upcoming Lava Bold 2 5G will feature an under-display fingerprint scanner for security, along with a hole punch display cutout to house the selfie camera. It will also ship with a dual rear camera unit, placed inside a rectangular camera island.
title: Lava Bold 2 5G India Launch Date Announced; Confirmed to Feature Under-Display Fingerprint Scanner

description: Apple’s MacBook Neo is a new entry-level laptop positioned below the MacBook Air (2025). It runs on the A18 Pro chip, while the MacBook Air (2025) is powered by Apple’s M4 processor. The MacBook Neo starts at Rs. 69,900 in India, whereas the MacBook Air (2025) begins at Rs. 99,900. Both laptops feature Liquid Retina displays and aluminium designs, but the Air offers higher performance, larger display options, more RAM and storage configurations, and longer battery life compared with the MacBook Neo.
title: MacBook Neo vs MacBook Air (2025): Price in India, Features and More Compared

description: Anthropic’s latest frontier artificial intelligence (AI) model, Claude Opus 4.6, has successfully identified several vulnerabilities in the Mozilla Firefox browser. The San Francisco-based AI firm announced that it had partnered with Mozilla to test the AI model’s capabilities in finding bugs in real-world scenarios. The researchers claimed that in just two weeks, Claude was able to find 22 different vulnerabilities, out of which 14 were classified as high-severity vulnerabilities.
title: Anthropic’s Claude Finds 22 Vulnerabilities in Mozilla Firefox in Just Two Weeks

description: Realme Note 80 has been launched in select South East Asian countries, including Indonesia, as the latest budget offering in the Chinese smartphone maker’s Note series. The handset is currently on sale in the country via the Realme Indonesia online store. It is offered in Glacier Blue and Storm Black colour options. The handset is available in 4GB+64GB and 4GB+128GB RAM and storage configurations. An octa core Unisoc T7250 chipset powers the new Realme Note series handset. It also packs a 6,300mAh battery with support for 15W wired charging.
title: Realme Note 80 Launched With 6,300mAh Battery, 6.74-Inch Display: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung has reportedly introduced an Inactivity restart security feature for Galaxy smartphones that automatically reboots a device if it stays locked for 72 hours. The option is available under Security and Privacy settings and places the phone in a restricted state after restarting until it is unlocked. The feature is intended to protect user data if a device is lost or stolen. It has been spotted on some Galaxy S25 units and the Galaxy Z Fold 7, but not yet on the Galaxy S26 series.
title: Samsung Galaxy Smartphones Get Inactivity Restart Security Feature With Latest Update: Report

description: WhatsApp regularly tests updates through beta versions before releasing them widely on Android and iOS. Reports indicate that several notable upgrades are in development, from subscription plans and parental controls to UI customisation and profile enhancements. Here are six upcoming WhatsApp features that could roll out in future updates on Android and iOS devices.
title: Six Upcoming WhatsApp Features That Could Soon Roll Out on iOS, Android

description: Bhartha Mahasayulaku Wignyapthi is a romantic drama about a Hyderabad winemaker who travels to Spain to prove the quality of his rejected wine and gets caught in rivalry, deception and complex relationships.
title: Bhartha Mahasayulaku Wignyapthi OTT Release Date Reportedly Revealed: When and Where to Watch Ravi Teja’s Romantic Drama Online?

description: Written and directed by Werner Herzog, Ghost Elephants is a biographical film that has finally landed on digital screens.
title: Ghost Elephants Out on OTT: Know Where to Watch This Biographical Film Online

description: Case renders for the Google Pixel 11 Pro XL, shared by accessory maker ThinBorne, hint at subtle design tweaks ahead of its expected launch. The images suggest the phone could retain a similar size while featuring a slightly less protruding camera bar with a wider, rounded rectangular shape. Reports also indicate Google may introduce an under-display infrared system for improved face unlock. The Pixel 11 lineup is expected to debut later in 2026.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro XL Case Listing Hints at Possible Design Changes to Camera Module

description: Hotel Barcelona, the horror roguelite action game from White Owls Inc, has just received a major update, titled 'Under New Management', that promises to overhaul gameplay systems and performance. With the release of the new update, we caught up with the game's creator, Hidetaka Suehiro (Swery65), and talked about Hotel Barcelona, the films that inspired the game, and much more in a wide-ranging interview.
title: 'Horror Isn't Just About Scaring People': Hidetaka Suehiro Talks Hotel Barcelona's Under New Management Update and Films That Inspired the Game

description: Poco C85x 5G will be equipped with a 6,300mAh battery, which is claimed to provide up to two days of battery life, the Chinese smartphone maker revealed on Monday. The new detail was revealed after the tech firm updated the dedicated microsite for the handset on Flipkart. The company has also confirmed that the upcoming Poco C85x 5G will sport a 6.9-inch display, delivering up to 120Hz of AdaptiveSync refresh rate, 240Hz of touch sampling rate, and TUV Rheinland Circadian Friendly, Low Blue Light, and Flicker Free certifications.
title: Poco C85x 5G Key Specifications, Features Revealed a Day Ahead of Launch in India

description: Poco has confirmed that the Poco X8 Pro series will launch on March 17 at 20:00 GMT+8 (5:30pm IST). The lineup is expected to include the Poco X8 Pro and Poco X8 Pro Max, both tipped to focus on improved performance. Reports suggest the phones could use MediaTek’s Dimensity 8500 Ultra and Dimensity 9500s chips. Pricing details have also surfaced online. The devices may be rebadged Redmi Turbo models and are expected to feature 1.5K OLED displays, large batteries, and high-speed charging support.
title: Poco X8 Pro Series Launch Date Announced; Poco X8 Pro Max Expected to Debut Alongside Poco X8 Pro

description: Rooster is a comedy-drama series about a novelist who becomes a writer-in-residence at a college while trying to reconnect with his struggling daughter.
title: Rooster Now Available for Streaming Online: What You Need to Know About its  Plot, Cast, and More

description: Samsung is reportedly considering adding vibe coding tools to its Galaxy smartphones. As per the report, the South Korean tech giant is looking into offering artificial intelligence (AI) tools that will allow users to customise first-party apps and the user interface however they like. This means that while users may not be able to perform heavy coding tasks, the tool will let them create and edit apps and system-level experiences.
title: Samsung Reportedly ‘Looking Into’ Adding Vibe Coding Tools in Future Galaxy Smartphones
Samsung’s Galaxy S26 Ultra Debuts the World’s First Built-in Privacy Display

description: Vivo V70 FE has been launched in Indonesia as the latest addition to the company’s Vivo V70 lineup. The phone was unveiled in the country along with the Vivo V70, which was recently launched in India. The handset is set to go on sale in Indonesia via the Vivo online store. It is offered in Blue, Light Purple, and Silver colour options, and will be available for purchase in 8GB+256GB and 12GB+256GB RAM and storage configurations. It is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 7360-Turbo chipset, paired with a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Vivo V70 FE Launched With 7,000mAh Battery, 200-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo X300s could be launched soon by the Chinese smartphone maker, as a company executive has revealed the key details, including the display features and camera configuration, of the upcoming handset. The Vivo X300s was earlier expected to be unveiled with the Vivo X300 Max moniker. However, Vivo’s Han Boxiao has now confirmed that the Max model will arrive as the Vivo X300s. The phone will be equipped with a 6.78-inch display, featuring BOE Q10 Plus luminescent material, while offering up to 144Hz of refresh rate. It is also shown to sport a hole punch display cutout for the selfie camera and a flat frame.
title: Vivo X300s Launch Teased Along With Display Features and Camera Configuration

description: Google introduced a new benchmark last week that evaluates artificial intelligence (AI) models based on their proficiency in developing Android apps. Dubbed Android Bench, the platform also ranks the models that perform the best in the tests, to help the developer community pick the right AI tools when building new apps and experiences for Android.
title: Google’s New Benchmark Will Rank the Best AI Models to Build Android Apps

description: The iPhone Fold is expected to be launched later this year as the first foldable from the Cupertino-based tech giant. The handset will reportedly debut along with the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. However, the company has yet to confirm the launch. Months ahead of its anticipated unveiling, the purported computer-aided design (CAD) renders of the book-style foldable have surfaced online, hinting at its design. The phone is shown to feature a dual rear camera unit, housed inside a horizontal pill-shaped camera module.
title: iPhone Fold Design Spotted in Leaked CAD Renders Months Ahead of Anticipated Launch Event

description: The SanDisk Extreme Fit USB‑C Flash Drive was launched in India on Monday. The company claims it to be the world’s smallest USB Type-C flash drive with a 1TB storage capacity. It is designed to provide additional storage without having to carry bulky external drives. The new flash drive features a compact “leave-in” design that sits flush with devices such as laptops and tablets. The SanDisk Extreme Fit supports up to 400MB per second data transfer speeds and is aimed at students, professionals, and mobile users.
title: SanDisk Extreme Fit USB Type-C Flash Drive Launched in India With Up to 1TB Storage: Price, Features

description: Apple is looking into ways to 3D print aluminium enclosures for the future Apple Watch models, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman writes in the latest edition of his Power On newsletter. The Cupertino-based tech giant could also be working on ways to manufacture aluminium enclosures for future iPhone models. This will reportedly help the iPhone-maker to bring greater efficiency to the manufacturing process of the Apple Watch and iPhone models. Gurman added that this decision builds on the tech giant’s move to use 3D printed titanium casings for the latest Apple Watch Ultra 3, which was launched in September 2025.
title: Apple Said to Consider 3D-Printed Aluminium Enclosures for Upcoming Apple Watch, iPhone Models

description: Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo suggests Apple may upgrade the next-generation MacBook Neo with the A19 Pro chip expected in the iPhone 17 Pro, along with 12GB RAM and a possible touchscreen display integrated into the IPS panel. macOS could also gain touchscreen optimisation before its launch. However, the device is likely at least a year away and plans may change. Separately, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman said Apple could expand “Neo” branding to other affordable devices, potentially renaming the Apple Watch SE lineup as Apple Watch Neo.
title: Apple’s MacBook Neo 2 Said to Launch With A19 Pro Chip and Touchscreen Display

description: Capcom has moved up the release date of Pragmata by a week. The sci-fi action-adventure game will now launch on April 17 across PC, PS5, Xbox Series S/X, and Switch 2. Pragmata was originally set to release on April 24. The game also received a new trailer at the Capcom Spotlight livestream.
title: Capcom Moves Up Pragmata Release Date, Will Now Launch on April 17

description: The Oppo Find N6 launch date for the global markets has been announced. It is expected to arrive as the successor to the Find N5, which was introduced in February 2025. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the China-based smartphone maker has teased the presence of a minimal crease on the book-style foldable. The Oppo Find N6 is also confirmed to support stylus input, utilising the Oppo AI Pen as an accessory.
title: Oppo Find N6 Global Launch Set for March 17; Company Teases AI Pen Support, Minimal Crease

description: Red Magic has teased an upcoming device called the Red Magic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro, though specifications and launch details remain undisclosed. The teaser image suggests a compact gaming tablet, continuing the company’s focus on smaller form factors. Reports indicate it could feature Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. Based on past launches, the Gaming Tablet 5 Pro may debut in China later this year before arriving globally under a different name.
title: Red Magic Gaming Tablet 5 Pro Launch Teased; Compact Gaming Device Expected to Debut Soon

description: The Samsung Galaxy M17e 5G will be launched in India later this month, the company announced on Monday. As per the South Korean tech conglomerate, the upcoming handset is designed to provide dependable performance for communication, content consumption, and everyday productivity. It is confirmed to sport a 6.7-inch HD+ screen with a 120Hz refresh rate. The Galaxy M17e 5G will be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G chipset, running on Android 16-based One UI 8.
title: Samsung Galaxy M17e 5G With 50-Megapixel Camera, 6,000mAh Battery to Launch in India on March 17: Features, Specifications

description: Apple CEO Tim Cook revealed the secret behind the company’s success during an interview on Sunday. The interaction was part of the Cupertino-based tech giant’s upcoming 50th anniversary on April 1. During the conversation, the executive also touched upon Steve Jobs’ legacy, the iPhone-maker's philosophy, and how it managed to stay among the top tech companies for the entirety of its existence.
title: Tim Cook Reveals the Secret Behind Apple’s Success, Says Can't Be Recreated

description: The OnePlus 15T is rumoured to launch in China soon as the successor to the OnePlus 13T, which was introduced in April 2025. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the company has released the first official image of the handset, revealing its overall look and camera layout. The upcoming handset appears to feature slim side bezels and a compact body, aligning with the company’s positioning of the phone as a small-screen flagship.
title: OnePlus 15T Design and Colour Options Officially Revealed Ahead of China Launch: Features, Specifications

description: Apple is said to be preparing to launch a new high-end laptop dubbed MacBook Ultra, following the launch of the MacBook Neo and M5-powered models last week. According to a report, the purported device could feature an OLED display and touchscreen support, marking a significant shift in Apple’s MacBook lineup. It is expected to debut later this year and may introduce a new top-tier category of Apple laptops rather than replacing the current MacBook Pro models.
title: Apple Reportedly Planning ‘MacBook Ultra’ With OLED Screen, Touch Support for 2026
